task.target: Household sometimes/often lacked enough food during prior7days

input_units.income_proxy: thousands USD/year, bracket proxy not observed amount
input_units.shock: household lost employment income past4weeks binary

task.timing_contract: Contemporaneous survey association; income-loss and food sufficiency recall windows overlap. No causal income effect or individual longitudinal forecast.
task.calibration: March2026 survey only; complete-region cross-validation; May2026 transfer without outcome calibration.
task.independent_unit: Household/respondent nested in Census region and wave; no linked March/May SCRAMIDs in released files. Four geographic aggregates are not independent populations.
task.scope_limits: Responding complete-case households; region-balanced HWEIGHT risk, not a national prevalence estimate. Bracket midpoints including175k open upper bracket are declared proxies; source topcodes preserved; missing/negative codes and nonpositive weights excluded, no imputation.

exposure.schema: Schema and source codebook aggregate tabulations inspected; no reserved respondent target or confirmation metric inspected. Source-aware public survey.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
